scope: The standing 1883 Barnet lighthouse with its square sandstone base, two attached domed service rooms, tapered tower, gallery, and diagonal-glazed lantern.

originalReview.notes: Dated NSW architect sheet with front elevation, middle section, end elevation and circular gallery plan of the surviving 1883 tower. The institution identifies this artwork as out of copyright.

quallaSearch.notes: The complete published Qualla article-gallery metadata was reviewed first. Its façade, lantern, and photographed drawing are all attribution-licensed. The independently sourced State Library scan is the original Barnet design sheet and carries an explicit out-of-copyright label.
